Dr. Mangone was beyond extremely kind and knowledgeable, he was also such a good listener and willing to work with me being on a budget since I am unfortunately in between jobs right now. He provided the most informed and compassionate care I’ve ever received for my
12 year old bunny and I appreciate it more than I can express in words. He is truly an amazing veterinarian and I would highly urge anyone with pet bunnies to schedule their next appointment with him to see for themselves what an incredible vet he is in every way. I wish I had found him a long time ago and am just blown away by how awesome he was. I genuinely wanted to hug him by the end of the appointment and cried tears of happiness and relief as soon as I got to my car. He is just so gifted and truly meant for this work. Thank you for providing my elderly bunny with the care and dignity she deserves and for being understanding of the fact that life unfortunately happens and sometimes people need a vet to be willing to be realistic with their recommendations regarding what the owner can afford. I have never struggled to pay for my bunnies veterinary care until now and have always been an advocate for knowing what you’re getting into when it comes to bringing home a pet, especially when it comes to vet bills. This has been a very difficult time for my bunny and I and the last vet I took her to, which I chose to try out instead of her usual vet due to their lower prices, was quite judgmental about me being on a budget and unwilling to provide any guidance or recommendations about what to do for her with the funds I had available and instead of even trying to work with me, I was presented with every option under the sun and left to decide what to do on my own. I was lectured about how to care for my bunny, who is 12 years old, without any acknowledgement of the fact that this is much due to the care I’ve provided her throughout her life. I left feeling like I wasn’t doing enough for her during this extremely trying time for both of us. I was beginning to lose hope and felt like I had failed her, but seeing Dr, Mangone was genuinely a breath of fresh air and the relief I feel knowing she has now been taken care of is insurmountable. Thank you for the impact you’ve made on Venom and I, it means so much and I wish I knew how to express the full lengths of my gratitude. Your work is so very appreciated and I will without a doubt be taking my other two buns here from now on as well.

I am very grateful to Dr. O'Brian and her team for saving Nicky's life, and Lia was very kind and supportive throughout the entire process; this veterinary clinic deserves more than five stars. I feel so lucky and happy that they saved my little baby's life.

My labradoodle was acting very strange early one morning. I called my vet explained the symptoms & they told me they didn’t have an appointment until the following Tuesday. I then called my neighbor’s vet, they were in surgeries all week. I then called Palm Glen Animal Hospital suggested by my neighbor’s vet. They had an opening in the morning, what time could I get there? I rushed my dog Nitro to the appointment & got right in to see Dr Carlson. I discussed Nitro’s symptoms & she said she would need to get X-rays but she thought it was his spine (oh no!) or something in his belly. Dr Carlson took him right away to get the X-rays which showed that poor Nitro was constipated (better than his spine!) They kept Nitro for a few hours to give the poor guy an enema & have him poop it out! I picked Nitro up later & he was still acting funny in the late afternoon, I called Dr Carlson & she said if we could get in right away, she could give him some medicine to help him. We got right into the car & went to the veterinary office. Dr Carlson met us in the waiting room & gave us the medicine with detailed explanation about how to administer & what to expect. Nitro was waaaaay better and the next day! I can’t say enough kind words for Dr Carlson & Palm Glen Animal Hospital & their staff. We were treated with kindness and compassion. Thank you so much for helping our boy Nitro to get back to his active self!

Palm Glen was a great vet and we'd been going for years, there is a similar review highlighting some of these points from another individual. We brought our cat a couple times to a Dr. Who dismissed our cats health problems as a diet issue, twice. After watching our cat continue to wither, he had lost half his body weight at the time of our visits. We then changed which Doctor we brought our Cat to, to which this Dr immediately acknowledged that our baby had a problem. We send the samples and get our test results back for our cat, and we got a diagnosis of what is wrong and we were told about Medication, but it has taken several days for them to send it to the Pharmacy, We've contacted the office several times with excuses of "we'll leave the doctor a note" the "doctor is in a visit call back at this time". Like the vibe of the clinic makes you feel like they're annoyed to answer questions or be helpful. I no longer recommend this clinic to my friends and family, if you want to watch your fur baby wither away while you have to play tug of war with Results and Medication, I'd try another place. On another side note I brought my dog here for health problems and he passed shortly after not to the fault of Palm Glen, but the test results for my dog, they never called us about them, we had to call them almost two weeks after the fact. I  have never written anything negative on a public format and it saddens me this is my first, I hope I never have to again. I just would like the Medication my cat needs without having to go to another vet in hopes they're faster after already spending the money with Palm Glen. I hope everyone who has had a good experience continues to do so, because once again I really liked this place a lot before this past year.

Hi Cynthia, thank you for your feedback. We apologize you were unsatisfied with your recent visit. For the safety and well-being of all animals, it is our policy that we do not call in prescriptions without a full exam, especially never having seen a pet before. When our team suggested alternative procedures or tests including oxygen therapy, hospitalization and antibiotic injection, to determine what was wrong with your rat, they were all declined. We do our best to offer exceptional veterinary care and customer service, so once again, we are sorry you did not feel this to be the case. If you wish to discuss anything further, please do not hesitate to contact us at your earliest convenience.

Update: it has been several years since my original post, and I still think very highly of Palm Glen, Dr. Mangone and the staff there.

I liked Dr. O’Brien she got the job done, the staff was a little cold and didn’t seem to care. My 140 lbs dog had surgery and I was told to pick her up at 2:15, an hour later she was discharged, I had to sit in the waiting room and listen to my dog bark which made me uneasy and no one seemed to care, from what the receptionist told me there was an emergency and it would be a longer wait time, understandable but my dog shouldn’t have been left alone post op in the process, once they brought her out the tech didn’t offer to help get her in to the SUV so that was cool. No one called to check on her, just didn’t seem like they treated my pet like a family member but more like a number.

Dr.Mangone and his staff were incredibly friendly and professional. It was quite a drive for us especially given the hour, but the care they gave our African Grey made it all worth it. We were apprehensive to take our parrot to a new vet but the immediately put us at a calm and were so good to our bird. They never once tried to upsell us or provide unnecessary treatments. I would not hesitate to return or bring our other pets here.

I have been to multiple Animal Hospital's and it always seems like they try to push extra unnecessary treatments and that is NOT the case with Palm Glen. You can tell they truly care about your pet and their well being and not just about upcharging for more services. Truly wonderful people that always have a smile on their face. They communicate with you every step of the way and ensure you are completely aware of what the treatment plan is for your pet.  I won't go any where else and neither should you.
The treatment there was professional and very kind. My sweet dog has glaucoma. And woke up blind. They got me in a couple of hours after I had called. That’s pretty fast for a busy vet.
Vet was so patient with our pet.  She took her time to gain his trust.  My dog ended up giving her kisses.  Loved the experience. She took good care of him.  Excellent service.
Very professional and friendly. Did not have a long wait which is appreciated when bringing in a sick pet. After I left I had questions and the vet called me and answered my questions promptly.

Dr. Mangone is extremely knowledgeable and always considers the best option for you and your pet. Hands down he is the best vet I have ever taken my animals to and will continue to go to him for future years. He his more concerned about your pets' health than trying to make extra money on unnecessary procedures.
